method.units: sold_estimate = active_codes - codes_remaining (validated against freebie_downloads_total: median error 0.3%). Counts LICENSE CODES, not purchases - 418/1057 tiers grant >1 code.
method.revenue: gross marketplace revenue (what buyers paid), NOT vendor net. AppSumo's split is not in this dataset. rev_floor/ceiling span min/max price-per-code across tiers; rev_point is exact for linear ladders, else the midpoint.
method.duration: start_date -> 2026-10-26 snapshot. end_date is populated for only 58/342 and is often a 2050 sentinel, so live campaigns are measured to the snapshot.
method.coverage: 203 of 342 products publish inventory; 133 publish nothing and are excluded rather than proxied.
